definition: D_X(t) = bare(X,t) - bare(X,gas), bare = Total Energy - CPCM dielectric - SMD CDS; dist_oxidation = D_cation - D_neutral, dist_reduction = D_neutral - D_anion

correction.sign_convention: d_total_ev = diel_ev + dist_ev + cds_ev + d4gcp_ev + residual_ev (verified to 0); dist_ev is stored signed as a contribution to the environment shift, so a positive dist_ev adds to the shift

reproducible_values.aggregation: per-molecule mean of dist_ev over the six bare-CPCM layers (5/10/20/40/80/200), 12 audited molecules

variational_check.note: D_X >= 0 is required: the solvent-adapted density is not the minimiser of the bare electronic energy, so relaxing back cannot lower it.

state_penalty.pseudoreplication_note: each molecule is one point; the six bare-CPCM layers are averaged first, because they are not six independent measurements
